name: harny
description: AI coding harness for VSCodium and VS Code — fast and packed with features, built on a SOLID core. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works out of the box.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode (an untrusted folder) Harny stays fully visible and works read-only: it can read, search and PREPARE changes as validated previews, but it does not write files, run commands or load the workspace's own skills until you trust the folder. Build comes back as soon as you do.

enumDescriptions: Follow the editor: Harny uses its light palette when the VS Code theme is a light one, its dark palette otherwise (default)
Always the dark palette (terracotta on anthracite), whatever the editor theme is
Always the light palette (terracotta on warm paper), whatever the editor theme is
harny.theme.description: Which of Harny's two palettes the chat panel uses. Harny keeps its own look in both: it does not adopt the theme's colors, it only follows its light/dark kind, so the panel re-skins instantly when you change theme.

scripts.build: node build/scripts/gen-view-css.mjs && node build/scripts/build-extension.mjs && node build/scripts/build-webview.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.mutate: stryker run tests/mutation/default.conf.json && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs default
scripts.mutate:compactor: stryker run tests/mutation/compactor.conf.json && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs compactor

scripts.mutate:overflow: stryker run tests/mutation/overflow.conf.json && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs overflow

scripts.mutate:mode-policy: stryker run tests/mutation/mode-policy.conf.json && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs mode-policy
scripts.mutate:webview: stryker run tests/mutation/webview.conf.json && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs webview
scripts.mutate:syntax: stryker run tests/mutation/syntax.conf.json && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs syntax
scripts.mutate:find: stryker run tests/mutation/find.conf.json && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs find

scripts.mutate:baseline: node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs default --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs compactor --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs loop-guard --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs overflow --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs tool-scope --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs mode-policy --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs webview --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs syntax --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs find --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs num-field --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs chat-panel --update && node build/scripts/mutation-gate.mjs session-recovery --update
scripts.mutate:ratchet: npm run mutate:compactor && npm run mutate:loop-guard && npm run mutate:overflow && npm run mutate:tool-scope && npm run mutate:mode-policy && npm run mutate:webview && npm run mutate:syntax && npm run mutate:find && npm run mutate:num-field && npm run mutate:chat-panel && npm run mutate:session-recovery
